verdict.rationale:
Segment's Engage/Audiences product is documented to build audiences from real-time tracking events and traits and sync them continuously to hundreds of ad/engagement destinations, powered by real-time identity resolution ('Powered by real-time data, Twilio Engage', 'Audiences let you group users... sync Audiences to hundreds of Destinations'). This directly matches the marketer story of continuous audience sync with dynamic membership.

missing for 10: explicit documentation/evidence of near-real-time membership entry/exit mechanics (e.g. incremental diff syncing) and independent/hands-on confirmation that ad-platform syncs actually update membership continuously rather than on a batch schedule.
